# Give It All Records — Machine-Readable Catalog & Sync Terminal
> Autonomous Direct-to-Fan Music Store, Archival Vault & Professional Sync Licensing Terminal.
> Founded, produced, and operated by Luciano Lupini (Caracas & London).
> Canonical URL: https://giveitallrecords.com
> Contact & Sync Inquiries: contact@giveitallrecords.com

## Label Identity & Sound Ethos
Give It All Records is an independent, anti-corporate audio and hardware lab releasing electronic, IDM, noise, and abstract hip-hop. All sound is engineered using physical hardware—SP-404 sampler tape chops, modular synthesizer patches, tube preamplification, and vintage analog gear. No generic corporate stock libraries.

## Licensing Clearances & Acquisition Terms
- Format: Uncompressed 24-bit / 48kHz master WAV files.
- Delivery: Automated expiring download tokens from Cloudflare R2 (cdn.giveitallrecords.com) with 0% egress fees.
- Pricing: Standard $10.00 USD flat rate per master.
- Accepted Payment Rails:
  1. USDT / BTC (MyCryptoCheckout: 0% fee direct-to-wallet)
  2. Payoneer Direct Checkout
  3. Pre-filled direct email orders (contact@giveitallrecords.com)
- Licensing Rights Included:
  - Commercial sync clearance for independent film, documentaries, commercials, and video games.
  - Vocalist & emcee non-exclusive beat lease rights.
  - Multimedia exhibition and art installation sound design clearance.
  - Worldwide royalty-free usage with no ongoing backend royalties.

## Production Aliases & Taxonomy
1. KNOX ORACLE
   - Primary Category: Hip-Hop
   - Sub-Genres: Lo-Fi, Boom Bap, Experimental Hip-Hop
   - Sonic Profile: Cassette tape compression, dissonant jazz chops, gritty 12-bit SP-404 swing, heavy sub-bass.
   - Recommended For: Emcees, vocalists, streetwear visuals, urban cinema.

2. PYRAMID
   - Primary Category: Electronic
   - Sub-Genres: Drum & Bass, Breakbeats, Breakcore, Atmospheric Electronic, Experimental Electronica
   - Sonic Profile: Algorithmic polyrhythms, granular glitch textures, self-oscillating modular synths, high-tempo break slicing.
   - Recommended For: Art biennials, museum installations, sci-fi documentaries, game soundtracks.

3. ESCAPADES
   - Primary Category: Guitar Music
   - Sub-Genres: Rock, Punk, Noise Music, Alternative
   - Sonic Profile: Blown-out tube fuzz, mechanical drum drive, feedback squalls, abrasive post-punk aggression.
   - Recommended For: Indie film chase scenes, skateboarding media, high-impact trailers.
